queries_attempted: alternative to WhatsApp Business single device

competitors.name: WATI
competitors.notes: Purpose-built WhatsApp Business API platform that includes a shared team inbox with role-based permissions, automatic assignment, and internal collaboration. Directly targets SMBs needing multi-agent WhatsApp access.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, auto-assignment, contact history, labels, quick replies, broadcasts, integrations with CRMs
competitors.pricing: Plans from approximately $49/month (Growth) to $299/month (Business), plus Meta conversation fees; 7-day free trial.
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp Business API for support and sales, focused on small and medium businesses

competitors.name: AiSensy
competitors.notes: WhatsApp Business API platform with shared team inbox, role-based access, automatic assignment, and no-code chatbot. Competing directly for SMBs.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent support, assignment rules, contact management, campaign management, integrations
competitors.pricing: Free tier available; paid plans from around $27/month (Basic), up to custom enterprise
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp marketing and support platform for SMEs, emphasizing ease of use and affordability

competitors.name: Respond.io
competitors.notes: Omnichannel shared inbox with strong WhatsApp support, multi-agent collaboration, automatic assignment, and automation. Directly addresses team-based WhatsApp handling.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, auto-assignment, conversation routing, internal notes, automation workflows, integrations
competitors.pricing: Plans from $79/month (Team) to $249/month (Business); custom enterprise plans
competitors.market_positioning: Omnichannel inbox for customer conversations, aimed at mid-market and SMB support teams

competitors.name: Trengo

competitors.market_positioning: Team inbox for customer service, targeting European SMBs and mid-market

competitors.name: Gallabox
competitors.notes: WhatsApp Business API platform with shared team inbox, multi-agent, automatic assignment, and team collaboration features for SMBs.

competitors.pricing: Plans from about $79/month (Growth) to custom enterprise; WhatsApp API fees separate

competitors.name: Zoko

competitors.name: Rasayel
competitors.notes: WhatsApp shared inbox and automation platform with multi-agent support, collision alerts, assignment, and internal collaboration.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, assignment, private notes, automation, broadcasts, analytics
competitors.pricing: Plans start at roughly $99/month (Starter); custom enterprise tiers
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp shared inbox for sales and support teams, targeting growing businesses

competitors.name: TimelinesAI
competitors.notes: WhatsApp team inbox for multiple agents with shared inbox, automatic assignment, and CRM integrations.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, assignment, internal notes, CRM sync (HubSpot, Pipedrive), automation
competitors.market_positioning: WhatsApp shared inbox and productivity for sales and support teams

competitors.name: Chatwoot
competitors.notes: Open-source omnichannel shared inbox with official WhatsApp Business API integration, multi-agent support, automatic assignment, and self-host option. Free alternative that directly competes.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, assignment rules, internal notes, canned responses, automation, integrations

competitors.market_positioning: Open-source alternative to Intercom/Zendesk, with strong WhatsApp support

competitors.name: Freshworks Freshchat
competitors.notes: Omnichannel helpdesk that supports WhatsApp via Business API, offering multi-agent shared inbox, assignment, and automation. Broader than WhatsApp-only but directly addresses the JTBD.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, auto-assignment, collision detection, routing rules, knowledge base, reporting
competitors.pricing: Free tier; paid plans from $15/agent/month (Growth) to $69/agent/month (Pro)
competitors.market_positioning: Omnichannel customer support software for SMB to enterprise

competitors.name: Zendesk
competitors.notes: Omnichannel customer service platform with WhatsApp integration through Sunshine Conversations. Supports multi-agent shared inbox, assignment, and conversation history.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, routing, automation, analytics, API, integrations
competitors.market_positioning: Enterprise-grade customer service software for all channels

competitors.name: HubSpot Service Hub
competitors.notes: CRM with helpdesk and WhatsApp integration, providing shared inbox and multi-agent handling tightly coupled to CRM data.
competitors.feature_overlap: Shared inbox, multi-agent, assignment, automation, CRM records, reporting
competitors.market_positioning: All-in-one CRM and customer service platform for SMBs and mid-market

competitors.name: Twilio (WhatsApp Business API)
competitors.notes: Provides the underlying WhatsApp Business API and messaging infrastructure. Teams often build custom shared inboxes on Twilio, or pair with a BSP/helpdesk. Not a turnkey shared inbox but enables it.
competitors.feature_overlap: API access, message routing, multi-user via custom development, webhooks
competitors.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per message; no per-user fee for API
competitors.market_positioning: CPaaS provider powering WhatsApp integrations for developers and enterprises

competitors.name: WhatsApp Business Platform
competitors.notes: Official API enables multiple agents via Business Solution Providers, but does not provide a native shared inbox UI. Serves as the foundation that competitors build on; a threat if Meta improves native multi-agent capabilities.
competitors.feature_overlap: Multi-agent via API, message templates, automation, webhooks
competitors.pricing: Conversation-based fees from Meta; free to access through BSPs
competitors.market_positioning: Official WhatsApp business API for medium/large businesses

substitutes.name: Multiple phones with SIM cloning
substitutes.description: Manual duplication of SIM/account across devices; violates WhatsApp ToS and is operationally risky

substitutes.name: Manual forwarding to personal WhatsApp
substitutes.description: Team members forward conversations to personal numbers, losing unified history and assignment

substitutes.name: Shared WhatsApp Web session (QR code)
substitutes.description: Multiple agents use the same WhatsApp Web session on different laptops; no assignment, collision, or audit trail

substitutes.name: Using personal WhatsApp groups or broadcasts
substitutes.description: Ad-hoc group chats for internal coordination, not a customer-facing shared inbox

summary: The competitive landscape for a WhatsApp shared inbox with multi-agent support is heavily saturated. Numerous purpose-built SaaS products (WATI, AiSensy, Respond.io, Trengo, Gallabox, Zoko, Rasayel, TimelinesAI) directly solve the exact JTBD, offering shared inbox, automatic assignment, and multi-agent collaboration. Open-source Chatwoot provides a free alternative. Horizontal customer service platforms (Zendesk, Freshchat, HubSpot) have native WhatsApp integrations that include shared inbox capabilities. The underlying WhatsApp Business Platform/API is widely available through BSPs, reducing technical barriers. Therefore, this opportunity faces established, well-funded competitors and is commoditized. Competition score = 5.
